title: Parameter file of the two-group RNA-seq differential-expression Skill
description: SYNTHETIC — FICTIONAL STUDY. Distilled from the GenomicsChain self-application subject V0 (a generated, fictional RNA-seq study); not real data, not a real study. The parameter file may be YAML or JSON; paths are relative to the working directory the Skill is run in.

sample_table.description: Tab-separated sample table. Lines starting with '#' are skipped; the first other line is the header. Must have a column 'sample' (reads are read from data/synthetic_reads/synthetic_<sample>.fastq.gz) and the column named by comparison.variable.

reference.description: The transcriptome the reads are quantified against.

transcripts.description: Transcript FASTA used to build the salmon index.

tx2gene.description: Tab-separated transcript-to-gene table with a header line; first column transcript id, second column gene id.

comparison.description: The comparison formula: the DESeq2 design and the two levels of one sample-table column that are compared (log2 fold change = numerator over denominator).

design.description: One-sided R model formula, e.g. '~ condition'. Must contain comparison.variable.

variable.description: Sample-table column that holds the two groups.

numerator.description: Level of comparison.variable in the numerator of the fold change.

denominator.description: Level of comparison.variable in the denominator of the fold change (the reference level). Every sample must carry the numerator or the denominator level.

significance_threshold.description: Adjusted-p-value threshold passed to DESeq2 results() as alpha (it governs independent filtering, and so the padj column).

permutation_seed.description: Seed for R's set.seed() before the label permutations.

permutation_draws.description: Number of random relabellings in the permutation check.
